import sys, random, time; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from verify import check as verify_model
from certcheck import validate_plan
from refreplay import ref_replay
from warmcheck import brute_warmup
import gen, gentrace, para, algo, simulator, topo
rng=random.Random(20240)
t0=time.time()
n=0; fails=0
for it in range(150):
    K=rng.randint(1,4)
    prof=gen.gen_profile(rng,K,consistent=(rng.random()<0.85))
    cal=para.Calibration(prof)
    if not cal.feasible: continue
    fab=gen.gen_fabric(rng,K=K,n=rng.randint(1,12))
    # widen the parameter ranges
    fab['interval_ns']=rng.choice([1,2,7,13,100,1000])
    fab['slice_ns']=rng.choice([1,3,11,64,997])
    import math
    Q=len(fab['slices'])
    P0=math.gcd(fab['interval_ns'],fab['slice_ns']*Q)
    if (fab['slice_ns']*Q)//P0 > 64: continue
    fab['offset_ns']=rng.randrange(fab['slice_ns'])
    fab['guards_ns']=sorted(rng.sample(range(0,(fab['slice_ns']-1)//2+1), min(3,(fab['slice_ns']-1)//2+1)))
    if not fab['guards_ns']: fab['guards_ns']=[0]
    # scale the delays and the deferrals
    for l in fab['links']:
        l['delay_ns']=[rng.randint(1,4*fab['interval_ns']) for _ in range(2)]
        l['defer_rounds']=[rng.randint(0,8) for _ in range(2)]
    # clamp the phase ranges to the new P
    P=topo.period_rounds(fab['interval_ns'],fab['slice_ns'],Q)
    fab['heat']=[h for h in fab['heat'] if h[2]<=P]
    fab['anchors']=[a for a in fab['anchors'] if a[2]<=P]
    fab['blackouts']=[b for b in fab['blackouts'] if b[2]<=P]
    n+=1
    if not verify_model(fab,prof,verbose=False):
        print('MODEL FAIL', it); fails+=1; break
    plan=algo.compile_plan(prof,fab)
    ok,msg=validate_plan(prof,fab,plan)
    if not ok: print('CERT FAIL',msg,prof,fab,plan); fails+=1; break
    if algo.audit(prof,fab,plan)!={'valid':True}: print('AUDIT FAIL',it); fails+=1; break
    if plan['guard_ns'] is not None:
        F=topo.Fabric(fab,cal)
        bw=brute_warmup(F,plan['guard_ns'],plan['pred'],plan['bounds_as'],plan['age_rounds'])
        if bw!=plan['warmup_cycle']: print('WARMUP FAIL',bw,plan['warmup_cycle']); fails+=1; break
    tr=gentrace.gen_trace(rng,prof,fab)
    g=rng.choice(fab['guards_ns'])
    a=simulator.replay_exact(prof,fab,g,tr); b=ref_replay(prof,fab,g,tr)
    if a!=b: print('REPLAY FAIL',it); fails+=1; break
print('soak: %d fabrics, %d failures, %.1fs'%(n,fails,time.time()-t0))
EOF
